about.title: From idea to achievement
paragraphs: Ruyat Al Injaz is your trusted partner in business solutions, backed by 10+ years of experience in e-services and 4+ years in company establishment. From idea to achievement, we help clients navigate their business needs with speed, credibility, and expertise.

We also proudly serve the guests of the Most Merciful, offering complete Umrah and Hajj coordination — from visa processing to hotels, transport, and catering — so every pilgrim's journey is seamless from start to finish.

items.question: What services does Ruyat provide?
items.answer: We offer company establishment, government liaison services, Umrah and Hajj coordination, licensing, residency applications, and full business support solutions.

items.question: Can foreign investors fully own a company through your services?
items.answer: Yes, we assist with company establishment under 100% foreign ownership in line with Saudi investment regulations.

items.question: Do you handle Umrah and Hajj arrangements for groups?
items.answer: Yes, we coordinate visas, hotels, transportation, and catering for both individual pilgrims and large groups.

items.question: How long does company registration typically take?
items.answer: Timelines vary by license type, but our team works to complete registration as quickly and efficiently as possible.

items.question: Do you offer ongoing administrative support after setup?
items.answer: Yes, we provide continuous administrative and commercial follow-up, including tax, Zakat, and commercial record services.
